business: We are a retailer selling men's and women's merchandise. Customers buy from us by phone, on our website, or both. We emailed customers who had bought from us in the last 12 months and tracked who visited our website in the following two weeks.
outcome: Lift = the share of customers who visited our website in the two weeks after the email, minus the share among similar customers who got no email (customers were split at random into Men's email, Women's email and no email).
limitation: The campaign descriptions are paraphrases: the dataset records only which email a customer was sent ("Mens E-Mail" or "Womens E-Mail"), not the subject line, copy, offer or images. Predictions can only use the merchandise focus of each email.
